name: Model Room
summary:
MATHEMATICS
Forty-one space curves in a coordinate box, each casting a dotted shadow onto all three walls. Viviani's curve makes the case alone: one curve whose three shadows are a circle, a parabola and a figure-eight. Twelve surfaces too — the plaster models this room is named after: a Möbius strip with one side, a Klein bottle with no inside.
